notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Version 1.01 brings with it 2 new adventure levels in the final space pack. We have been pretty happy with the length of the adventure mode in 1.0 but we still wanted to spend a bit more time on the final levels to make them really special. And although they are the last levels in the lineup they still manage to explore entirely new mechanics and combinations. From googly eyed penguins, to bubble fields and gravity blocks, these levels have a lot to offer.

Along with the new levels we also focused on fixing various things based on feedback from the community. We added a bunch of new features to the minimap to help with finding secrets and tracking down those last few diamonds. We fixed a bunch of things related to fast traveling and we even added sound effects to sheep!

As always, there is a boat-load of other changes and I don't have the ability to list every one of them here. If you want to know what else has changed you can check out the changelog at https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-101-changelog

Version 1.1 also lines up with the Steam Summer Sale so the game will be on sale for the next couple of weeks. If you or someone you know has been waiting to get the game this is an excellent opportunity to get it while it's cheaper.

We hope you are enjoying the game! If you have any suggestions or comments don't hesitate to reach out to us on Discord or the Discussion board on Steam.

notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.notes:
It's finally here! Version 1.0 is finally finished and boy is it a whopper! We spent a lot of time over the last couple of months finishing testing, revising, and re-finishing all of the adventure levels for version 1.0 as well as working on a whole new soundtrack with 7 different themes for the 7 different packs. Of course it's not just new levels and music. We have changed, fixed, and added so many things in this version that I don't even know how to sum it all up. In a nutshell, the game is more complete than it was a month or two ago for sure.

Version 1.0 marks the moment we are considering the game out of Early Access and properly "finished" for people to buy. We have a strong set of levels and puzzles (over 250 puzzles now) and the game does everything it needs to in order to provide an enjoyable experience that is worth the asking price. However, version 1.0 will not be the last version! We will still be working on and changing things as time goes on and I'm sure there will be some hot fixes for problems found over the next couple of weeks. As always we look forward to the future and we would love any feedback or comments you have on the game. You can always join our Discord server to see live updates and screenshots and talk with the community.

With the adventure levels done our next goal is to try out some in-engine level sharing ideas like the Steam Workshop and maybe even our own backend for hosting levels. We will also be looking to port the game to various platforms like OSX and Linux as well as potentially Nintendo Switch so look out for news on that.

Thank you to all who have participated in our Early Access process! We hope you all enjoy the game!

New Trailer: https://youtu.be/T5lt-aCkOwk

Full Changelog: https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-10-changelog

notes.title: Version 0.13
notes.notes:
Alright so it's been a bit of a longer stretch between versions again, though unlike last time it's because we've been trying to prepare for our release from Early Access into version 1.0 of the game. This is just the first of a few version coming out in the next few months that will change major content aspects of the game like the adventure levels, cutscenes, music, and sound effects.

We are planning to try and hit an official release for the game in March of this year and we are super excited (and also very busy) because of that. We hope you've been enjoying the game over the last year. This february marks our 1 year anniversary of early access! Can you believe it? I know I can't.

As always I recommend you checkout the full changelog for this version on our site if you want to see a list of all of the things that have been added or changed in this version of the game: https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-013-changelog

notes.title: Version 0.12
notes.notes:
This past weekend was quite a trip. If you didn't hear, we were selected to be one of the games at the Seattle Indies Expo which means we've been in a bit of a crunch trying to get everything ready for that. You can check out the broadcast that happened last Saturday on Twitch while the VOD still lasts at https://www.twitch.tv/videos/739120166. I believe there will be a youtube version uploaded sometime soon as well. So that was an awesome experience and we're very thankful for the opportunity to be in the lineup.

The offshoot of this presentation is that we've gotten a ton of major stuff done in the game. A bunch of the adventure levels have been totally redone or replaced and many of the ones near the beginning have been redecorated and fixed in various ways. So make sure you check out the adventure levels even if you've already played them before. We also totally redid the adventure section of the main menu so it looks a lot nicer and gives you an overview of your progress on the adventure levels.

As always there are so many things that I could mention have changed but the best way to find out all of the new stuff that has been added is to check out the changelog at [url=www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-012-changelog]www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-012-changelog[/url]

Because of this major update on our spot on Seattle Indies Expo we are doing a short sale this week so if you haven't picked up the full game yet make sure you get it now while it's 50% off.

notes.title: Version 0.11
notes.notes:
So last time we released 7 mini-updates, this time we made it to 8 before I got off my lazy butt and packaged a proper major version. Luckily this means that this version also has a LOT of stuff. As always make sure you check out the full changelog for a list of all of the things that have been added. You can [url=https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-011-changelog]find it on our website[/url] or select "Changelog" from the main menu in the game.

There are so many things that have been added since version 0.10. The most recent additions coming in this version that weren't in the last mini-update are largely centered around the way diamonds look and the new menu that shows up when you complete a level. We also experimented with adding the snowball+snowman mechanics from A Good Snowman is Hard to Build as well as a bunch of new tree and mushroom decorations. We also made a bunch of smaller tweaks to mechanics though like spikes acting like carpet and destroying boxes and teleporters swapping places of two entities rather than just blocking teleportation.

We hope everyone is enjoying the game and we are looking forward to adding much more soon! (Maybe this time we can get the next major version out in less than 2 months)

notes.title: Version 0.10 Released
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we are finally ready to release the next major version of the game. We've been working on mini-updates for version 0.09 over the last month and while each update is relatively small on their own they have combined to make version 0.10 have a massive list of changes. We've released 7 different mini-updates since version 0.09 so make sure you check out the full changelog to see what's been updated.

Since the last mini-update we have been focusing on adding some music to the game and although the songs will still need some work, we think having proper music has made a huge difference to the feel of the game. You can also use these new music tracks in your own levels by using the Music Queue entity.

We also just added 2 new meta entities called the Trigger Relay and Trigger Gate that allow you to perform more complicated trigger logic. These entities can help you delay a trigger, forward a trigger from one group to another, and, since the gate entity is basically a fully functioning transistor, you can create basically any logic gate you might need.

We also had a bit of fun on the last livestream expanding the command line options for the game, adding some easter eggs and cheats in the process, so make sure you check it out to find out what options are available. Or you can probably just ask us for the list if you join our Discord channel: [url=https://discord.gg/JQaertK]https://discord.gg/JQaertK[/url]

Other than these most recent changes there are a ton of new things to check out from the mini-updates. We added a bunch of bubble entity variants, googly eyes that attach on boxes, better broom sweeping mechanics, single use portals, a display screen entity, new logic for the Random and Run From Player AI types, sword collisions, an input visualization UI element, a custom glyph entity, and so much more. Make sure you check out the full changelog for a complete list of changes here: [url=https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-010-changelog]https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-010-changelog[/url]

We hope everyone is doing well and we're looking forward as always to adding a bunch of new things to the game in the near future.

notes.title: Version 0.09
notes.notes:
We've finally got version 0.09 of the game ready to release!

This version includes a completely new main menu system which also supports some new features like multiple save files and completion percentages. However, we also added a bunch of new entities and mechanics at the same time. We added ice blocks that can freeze monsters and turn them into pushable blocks, occlusions clouds which dissipate when walked over and block monsters from walking under them, ground cover which covers things below them and can be swept up with a broom, and much more. Check out the full changelog for more details here: [url=https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog]https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog[/url]

Also this week we are going to be starting our first attempt at running a non-formal level design contest. We are mostly interested in getting ourselves and others excited to work on levels and to give enough of a structure that it should be easier to get started making levels. There's not going to be any prizes for the winners but we will announce the winners on our website and discord. If you are interested in participating checkout our website for the details: [url=https://www.princesscastlequest.com/contest]https://www.princesscastlequest.com/contest[/url] This is our first time trying to organize things but it definitely won't be our last contest. We are planning to try and do either bi-weekly or monthly contests with a different theme every time. The exact plan and format of these contests will probably change and adapt as we learn what works best.

We want to thank everyone who has downloaded the demo or purchased the game on Steam! If you like the game we would love to hear from you! You can talk to us on discord using the following invite link: [url=https://discord.gg/JQaertK]https://discord.gg/JQaertK[/url] Every piece of feedback is a big deal for us and we appreciate everyone's support so far. We hope you enjoy this latest update!

notes.title: Version 0.08 is Here (Free Demo Now Available)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we are back for another update to the game! For most of March we have been working towards making a free Demo version of the game but we have also added some new features and changes that you might find exciting. Also with the demo now available it's a great time to test it out if you haven't bought it already or tell your friends about the demo if you have.

Due to the way Steam works we have to wait for the demo to be approved and then it takes 2 weeks before we can set it live. So the demo will be available on Steam, but not for another 2 weeks or so. However you can get the demo through our itch.io page right now! Just follow the link below and download the demo zip file:

[h3][url=https://princesscastlequest.itch.io/demo]https://princesscastlequest.itch.io/demo[/url][/h3]
[url=https://princesscastlequest.itch.io/demo][img]https://i.imgur.com/3onml9O.png[/img][/url]

Here's a list of the major things that were added in version 0.08. You can check out the changelog link below to get a full list of all of the changes:
[list]
[*] Added a bunch of new wall and ground types
[*] Added lasers, receptacles, and mirrors
[*] Added a new painter entity that can paint entities different colors (including the princess)
[*] Added a popup wall entity which becomes solid after walking off it
[*] Moved user levels into the AppData folder and fixed id conflicts when updates happen
[*] Added some new dog variants
[/list]

Full Changelog: [url=https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-008-changelog]https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-008-changelog[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.07 is Released
notes.notes:
Today is finally the day for our first major update to the game after Early Access Release. We have been working hard to fix and push forward on many different fronts.

You can check out the full changelog for version 0.07 here: [url=https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-007-changelog]https://www.princesscastlequest.com/changelog/version-007-changelog[/url]

Our main focus has been to redo the adventure levels with some new design goals in mind. We have been testing the game among various friends and family and found what we think to be the biggest problems with our original designs. Some of the puzzles in the original levels have been reused or adapted to the new format but we also have a bunch of new puzzles mixed in, as well as a whole new set of secrets and hidden puzzles.

Alongside making new levels we have also been working on updating the options for all of the entities in the game. Adding options that need to be there, reorganizing and simplifying options, and adding new functionality to some entities like Long Arm pistons and Gravity on Boxes. We also have added some brand new entity and wall types like the Require Door, Puzzle and Secret Regions, A Lava wall Type, and a Firefly.

We also have made a new level which is intended to be used when we go to trade-shows or meetups and want to have people play the game in shorter play sessions. The Demo Showcase contains 20 different puzzles packed close together and can be completed in any order. These are some of our favorite puzzles we have made so far so if you are looking for a less linear and more condensed experience of the mechanics in the game right now feel free to check it out!

We hope you are enjoying the game. As always if you have any feedback or encounter a bug feel free to join our Discord Server at [url=https://discord.gg/JQaertK]https://discord.gg/JQaertK[/url] or email us at PrincessCastleQuest@gmail.com

Thank you all so much for your support and we will be back soon with more features in the next update!
